_comment: The single authoritative definition of the NIT Raipur pilot. India stays the broad OSINT/GEOINT coverage area; NIT Raipur is the detailed demonstrator. NO coordinates are typed in here: the provisional study area is derived at runtime from a staged gazetteer place, and a verified campus boundary replaces it automatically once its file exists (see boundary.verified_file).
description: Detailed pilot study area for imagery archive, segmentation, change detection, land-cover, construction and vegetation analysis, and evidence-grounded review at a single, well-known site.

study_areas.name: NIT Raipur study area
study_areas.description: Working area around the campus used to scope searches and stage imagery.

study_areas.name: NIT Raipur Campus
study_areas.description: The campus itself. Needs a verified campus boundary; until then searches scoped to it report NOT STAGED.

provisional.source: Natural Earth populated place 'Raipur' (city reference point, staged in data/boundaries/india-places.geojson)
provisional.meaning: A square search area centred on Raipur's city reference point. It is NOT the campus boundary and is not authoritative; it only scopes searches and imagery staging until a verified boundary is supplied.

data_registry.name: Campus boundary
data_registry.expected_format: GeoJSON / Shapefile / GeoPackage polygon (EPSG:4326 or UTM 44N)
data_registry.source: NIT Raipur estate office (expected) or a verified public survey
data_registry.notes: Replaces the provisional study area when placed at data/pilots/nit-raipur/campus-boundary.geojson.

data_registry.name: Site / master plan
data_registry.expected_format: Georeferenced PDF/GeoTIFF or CAD (DXF/DWG) with control points
data_registry.notes: Needed to link detections to planned buildings and zones.

data_registry.name: Building footprints / inventory
data_registry.expected_format: Polygon layer with building id, name, use (e.g. hostel, academic), year built
data_registry.source: Estate office (expected); public footprints as a fallback
data_registry.notes: Required for 'near the hostels' and 'buildings added after' questions; segmentation validation.

data_registry.name: Roads / pathways
data_registry.source: Estate office or public map data (expected)
data_registry.notes: Only generalised national roads (Natural Earth 1:10m) are staged today; they are not campus roads.

data_registry.name: Land-use / land-cover
data_registry.expected_format: Polygon or raster classes with a legend
data_registry.source: Institute or derived from imagery with labels (expected)
data_registry.notes: Training and validation reference for land-cover classification.

data_registry.name: Historical construction / change records
data_registry.expected_format: Table: structure, start date, completion date, location reference
data_registry.notes: Ground truth for earliest-date error evaluation.

data_registry.name: Historical imagery (Sentinel-2 L2A)
data_registry.expected_format: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF windows via the existing archive pipeline
data_registry.notes: Can be staged with the existing ingest-imagery pipeline once the study area is confirmed; deliberately not staged on a provisional area.

data_registry.name: Ground-truth change events
data_registry.expected_format: Table/GeoJSON: location, change type, date or date range, evidence

data_registry.name: DEM / topography
data_registry.source: Public DEM (e.g. Copernicus DEM) or survey (expected)

data_registry.name: Authorized drone / orthomosaic imagery
data_registry.expected_format: GeoTIFF orthomosaic with capture date and GSD
data_registry.notes: Only flights with explicit institutional authorization will be accepted.
